scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
